rule: Of the policies (P0 the threshold alone, P1 the text exemption, P5 the text exemption with the non-default parameter triggers) and the thresholds of the chosen signal, the (policy, threshold) with the lowest list-price cost per 100 items whose development success is at least B2's minus 0.02; ties go to fewer routed items, then the lower threshold, then the policy listed first (docs/m6-计划.md §3.3 C3).
